const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Control script for the RoboLab rubiks_cube_and_banana episode.
+
+Run from a Python environment with /opt/tools on PYTHONPATH. Coordinates below
+were estimated from the calibrated overhead RGB-D camera and checked against
+the shoulder and wrist views.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+DT = 1.0 / 15.0
+DOWN = [-2.98e-7, -0.7071068, 0.7071068, 0.0]
+CUBE_XY = (0.448, -0.067)
+BANANA_XY = (0.524, -0.075)
+BOWL_XY = (0.402, 0.130)
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+
+
+def save_obs(result, name: str) -> None:
+    from PIL import Image
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for camera, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(d / f"{camera}.jpg", quality=92)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+def move_xyz(robot: Robot, xyz, duration: float, grip: float, label: str):
+    """Smoothly interpolate a joint-space path to a calibrated TCP pose."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+    q0 = now[:7]
+    quat = now[11:15] if np.linalg.norm(now[11:15]) > 0.99 else np.asarray(DOWN)
+    ik = robot.ik({"tcp": list(map(float, xyz)) + list(map(float, quat))}, seed=q0)
+    if not ik.get("ok"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed for {label}: {ik}")
+    q1 = np.asarray(ik["q"], dtype=np.float64)
+    n = max(1, int(round(duration * 15)))
+    rows = []
+    for i in range(1, n + 1):
+        t = i / n
+        s = t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
+        rows.append(np.r_[q0 + s * (q1 - q0), grip])
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows), dt=DT, video="mp4",
+                          note=label)
+    result.save(str(RUNS / label))
+    save_obs(result, label)
+    print(label, "done=", result.done, "reason=", result.meta.get("reason"),
+          "clipped=", result.meta.get("clipped"), "plan=", result.meta.get("plan"),
+          "tcp=", result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15])
+    return result
+
+
+def hold_gripper(robot: Robot, grip: float, seconds: float, label: str):
+    now = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds * 15)))
+    rows = np.tile(np.r_[now[:7], grip], (n, 1))
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=DT, video="mp4", note=label)
+    result.save(str(RUNS / label))
+    save_obs(result, label)
+    print(label, "done=", result.done, "reason=", result.meta.get("reason"),
+          "tcp=", result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[8:15])
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    print("status", robot.status())
+    print("spec budget", robot.spec().get("budget"))
+    # Add the verified pick-and-place stages here as the live episode proceeds.
+    move_xyz(robot, (*CUBE_XY, 0.22), 2.0, 0.0, "cube_approach")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
